review_findings.description: After the area contradiction, the noninjectivity-to-impossible-area premise is logically equivalent to injectivity; meridian, exterior, surgery transport, and actual barrier production are not separately exported.
Real empty infimum equals zero. Attainment must be supplied when claiming genuine least-area disks.
Exact parametrized smooth embedded immersed disks, no boundary branch points, prescribed side. No minimality, stability, or mean convexity in the definition.
Actual same-tower post-event physical metric at nonnegative times; times below zero clipped to zero; loops needed only at or after their own threshold.
